🎬 House M.D. (2004–2012)

House M.D. follows Dr. Gregory House, a brilliant but unconventional medical genius who leads a team of diagnosticians at Princeton-Plainsboro Teaching Hospital in New Jersey. Known for his extraordinary intelligence, sharp sarcasm, and complete disregard for traditional rules, House specializes in solving mysterious medical cases that leave other doctors searching for answers. Despite his remarkable abilities, his difficult personality, chronic leg pain, and dependence on pain medication frequently create problems with colleagues, patients, and hospital administrators. Working alongside a talented team of doctors, House investigates rare illnesses, unexpected symptoms, and life-threatening conditions, often using controversial methods to uncover the truth. Each case becomes a complicated puzzle filled with misleading clues, surprising discoveries, and difficult ethical decisions. Meanwhile, his complicated friendship with Dr. James Wilson and frequent conflicts with hospital administrator Dr. Lisa Cuddy reveal a more vulnerable side beneath his cynical personality. As the series progresses, House struggles with loneliness, addiction, trust, and the consequences of pushing away the people who care about him. Through gripping medical mysteries, clever dialogue, emotional confrontations, and unforgettable characters, the show challenges conventional ideas about morality, compassion, and professional responsibility. Combining medical drama, dark humor, psychological depth, and compelling storytelling, House M.D. explores genius, friendship, sacrifice, addiction, human behavior, and the relentless pursuit of truth.

🎭 Genre: Medical Drama • Mystery • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 8.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 42–44 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creator: David Shore

📺 Where to Watch: Check Hulu, Peacock, and Amazon Prime Video for current streaming availability in the United States. Availability varies by region.
